title: LLMs as mirrors of societal moral standards: reflection of cultural divergence and agreement across ethical topics

bias_targets.methodology: The paper measures cross-cultural moral bias using three methods: (1) comparing the variances of model-generated moral scores with survey-based empirical moral scores across different countries, (2) assessing the alignment between country clusters derived from model-generated scores and those derived from survey data (World Values Survey and PEW), and (3) probing LLMs with direct comparative prompts to evaluate their recognition of cultural differences and similarities in moral judgments.
